textoCompleto: Once upon a time, in a peaceful forest, there lived a very proud hare. The hare was always boasting about how fast he could run. 'No one is faster than me!' he would say to anyone who would listen. One day, the hare saw the tortoise walking slowly. 'Look at you, tortoise! You are so slow. It takes you forever to get anywhere!' said the hare, laughing. The tortoise, tired of the hare's arrogance, replied calmly, 'You may be fast, but I challenge you to a race.' The hare thought this was very funny. 'A race? With you? This will be easy!' The other forest animals gathered to watch. The fox was the judge. 'Ready, set, go!' The hare ran very fast and quickly disappeared ahead. After a few minutes, the hare looked back and could not see the tortoise. 'This is too easy. I have time to rest,' said the hare. He found a shady tree and decided to take a short nap. Meanwhile, the tortoise continued walking. He did not stop. He did not give up. Step by step, he kept moving forward. The hare slept for a long time. When he finally woke up, the sun was low in the sky. He ran to the finish line as fast as he could. But when he arrived, the tortoise was already there, resting. The forest animals cheered for the tortoise. The hare could not believe it. 'How did you win?' asked the hare. The tortoise smiled and said, 'You are faster, but I never gave up. Slow and steady wins the race.' The hare learned an important lesson that day: never underestimate others, and consistency is more important than speed.
